Three weeks left to respond to our client money consultation

Published 6 November 2026

There are three weeks left to respond to our consultation on accountant's reports for firms that hold client money.

As we set out on 2 October 2026, we propose that every firm holding client money must send us an accountant's report every year, with a fixed penalty for late or missing reports.

The consultation closes on 27 November 2026. We have received a good number of responses so far and encourage firms of all sizes to reply.

Northbridge Legal Standards Authority. Test page, not a real regulator.
